items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (BlockStrap RCE)
items.summary: This update addresses a critical template engine injection vulnerability (BlockStrap) that could lead to unauthenticated remote code execution. The bulletin also resolves several other critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including privilege escalation and arbitrary file system write issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin resolves multiple critical vulnerabilities, including Stored Cross-site Scripting (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and Incorrect Authorization flaws, many of which can be exploited without authentication and lead to privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying the September 2026 isolated patch.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler RCE)
items.summary: This emergency update addresses a critical zero-day vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. Adobe confirmed active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Unauthenticated Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update resolves critical vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1, which requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction. Successful exploitation could also lead to arbitrary code execution and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (PolyShell RCE)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses a critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability (PolyShell) that could lead to arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. The vulnerability has been actively exploited in the wild and was added to the CISA KEV catalog.
